5	/**
6	 * Server Supabase client for Server Components, API Route Handlers, and Server Actions.
7	 *
8	 * Uses the anon key + user session cookies.
9	 * RLS policies apply based on the authenticated user.
10	 *
11	 * IMPORTANT: cookies() is async in Next.js 16 — must be awaited.
12	 */
13	export async function createClient() {
14	  const cookieStore = await cookies()
15	
16	  return createServerClient<Database>(
17	    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
18	    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY!,
19	    {
20	      cookies: {
21	        getAll() {
22	          return cookieStore.getAll()
23	        },
24	        setAll(cookiesToSet) {
25	          try {
26	            cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =>
27	              cookieStore.set(name, value, options)
28	            )
29	          } catch {
30	            // setAll called from a Server Component — cookies cannot be set
31	            // middleware handles session refresh
32	          }
33	        },
34	      },
35	    }
36	  )
37	}
38	
39	/**
40	 * Service-role Supabase client for webhook handlers and admin operations.
41	 *
42	 * Bypasses RLS. NEVER expose to client. Only use server-side.
43	 */
44	export function createServiceRoleClient() {
45	  const serviceRoleKey = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
46	  if (!serviceRoleKey) {
47	    throw new Error('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY is not set')
48	  }
49	
50	  return createServerClient<Database>(
51	    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
52	    serviceRoleKey,
53	    {
54	      cookies: {
55	        getAll() {
56	          return []
57	        },
58	        setAll() {
59	          // No-op for service role — no session cookies
60	        },
61	      },
62	      auth: {
63	        autoRefreshToken: false,
64	        persistSession: false,

  ON public.profiles FOR SELECT
  USING (
    -- Users can always read their own profile
    id = auth.uid()
    OR
    -- Team members of the same studio can read each other
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.studio_members sm_viewer
          JOIN public.studio_members sm_target
            ON sm_viewer.studio_id = sm_target.studio_id
         WHERE sm_viewer.user_id = auth.uid()
           AND sm_target.user_id = profiles.id

  );

    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.tables
     WHERE table_schema = 'storage'
       AND table_name = 'objects'

 * Cached helper that validates the session and returns the authenticated user

export const getAuthenticatedUser = cache(async (): Promise<AuthenticatedUser | null> => {
  const supabase = await createClient()
  const { data: { user }, error: authError } = await supabase.auth.getUser()

  if (authError || !user) return null

  const [profileResult, memberResult] = await Promise.all([
    supabase
      .from('profiles')
      .select('id, email, full_name, avatar_url, is_platform_admin, created_at, updated_at')
      .eq('id', user.id)
      .single(),

      .limit(1)
      .single(),
  ])

  if (profileResult.error || !profileResult.data) return null
  if (memberResult.error || !memberResult.data) return null

  return {
    user: { ...profileResult.data, authId: user.id },
    studioId: memberResult.data.studio_id,
